title: Canonical completed integral coefficient comparison and exact transport
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R$ and uniformizer $t$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and any scheme $X$ on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $R^\uparrow$ be the coefficient-universe lift of $R$, and let $P_n=R^\uparrow/(t^{n+1})$ be the finite quotients in the completed coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Define the quotient ring isomorphism $q_n:P_n\simeq(R/(t^{n+1}))^\uparrow$ by $[x]\mapsto[x.\mathrm{down}].\mathrm{up}$. Compose the inverse normalized constant-functions comparison with the constant sheaf of $q_n$, and forget commutativity [def-weil-pbc-adic-lisse-module], to obtain $c_n$ from the continuous-function level sheaf to the intrinsic level sheaf. Let $B^{\rm pbc}$ be the completed continuous-function presentation [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower] and $B^{\rm det}$ the inverse-limit coefficient sheaf [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Define $c:B^{\rm pbc}\simeq B^{\rm det}$ as the unique ring-sheaf comparison satisfying $c;\pi_n^{\rm det}=\pi_n^{\rm pbc};c_n$ for every $n\in\mathbf N$. Restriction along $c$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars] has its actual sectionwise action and the recorded finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation witnesses. Define $\operatorname{Transport}:D(\operatorname{Mod}(B^{\rm det}))\to D(\operatorname{Mod}(B^{\rm pbc}))$ as termwise localization of this exact restriction functor [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]; its source is the completed-coefficient module category [def-sf-scalar-reduction-categories-restriction]. The quotient, level and completed comparisons and the exact restriction/transport are fixed constructions, with no constructibility, completeness, Noetherian or dimension hypothesis.
